fields.description: The payment this tax was withheld from, on a Work Order row; empty on a Non-Project Expense row. A row links to exactly one of this and Non-Project Expense, never both and never neither. UNIQUE, and that constraint IS the idempotency guarantee: the Approved transition can fire more than once (a re-save, a retried bulk action) and only the first attempt can write a row - which is also what stops the payment amount being reduced twice. Deleting the payment deletes this row.
fields.label: Project Payment

fields.description: The payment's parent doctype, snapshotted. Today only "Service Requests" is deducted from; the field mirrors Project Payments' own shape so a later ledger needs no migration.
fields.label: Document Type

fields.description: Snapshotted from the payment so a vendor-wise filing report needs no join.
fields.label: Vendor

fields.description: The payment's amount BEFORE tax was withheld. ⚠️ THE ONLY SURVIVING RECORD OF IT - Project Payments.amount is rewritten to the net figure when this row is created, so this field is what makes that rewrite auditable and reversible.
fields.label: Gross Amount

fields.description: ⚠️ THE RATE AS APPLIED, SNAPSHOTTED — never re-read from the vendor later. Vendors.tds_deduction_percentage can be edited, and a historical deduction must not silently restate itself at the new rate.
fields.label: TDS Percentage

fields.description: gross_amount x tds_percentage / 100, rounded to 2 decimals. This is the figure Service Requests.total_tds sums. The NET figure is not stored here - after this row is written, Project Payments.amount IS the net, so a second copy could only drift.
fields.label: TDS Amount

fields.description: Pending until this deduction is paid to the department under a TDS challan (see TDS Challan). Set to Paid by the Pay TDS action, never by hand.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The ITNS 281 challan this tax was deposited under.
fields.label: TDS Challan

fields.description: The day the payment reached Approved and the tax was withheld. Renamed from `deducted_on` (same data, truer name) -- the column carries the APPROVAL date, which for the backfilled rows is years before the row itself was written.
fields.label: Payment Approved On

fields.description: RETIRED, READ-ONLY, FROZEN. The pre-rename copy of Payment Approved On, kept only until the column is dropped by hand. Nothing writes it any more: a deduction recorded after the rename fills Payment Approved On and leaves this empty, so it is a snapshot of the old rows and must never be read as the live date.
fields.label: Deducted On (retired)

fields.description: Who bears this tax, set once when the deduction is created and never changed after. Vendor: withheld from the vendor, the payment cut to the net. Company: paid by the company on top, the payment kept whole (a Work Order whose categories were all Miscellaneous / Transportation Services at that moment, services/payment_tds.is_company_borne). Every reader (Amount Due, the mismatch report, an amount edit, the request cap, the Work Order page) reads this, never the Work Order's categories, which may change later (#1451).
fields.label: TDS Borne By

fields.description: The Non-Project Expense this tax was withheld from (Office Rent, section 194-I); empty on a Work Order row. A row links to exactly one of this and Project Payment, never both and never neither (services/payment_tds.deduction_link_problem, on every save). UNIQUE like Project Payment: that constraint is what lets one expense carry at most one tax record.
fields.label: Non-Project Expense

fields.description: Who the tax was withheld from when they are not a Vendor record: the landlord of an Office Rent expense, snapshotted from the request's answers when the tax is withheld. Empty on a Work Order row, which names its Vendor instead.
fields.label: Deductee Name

fields.description: The deductee's PAN, snapshotted with Deductee Name. Empty on a Work Order row, which reads its Vendor's PAN.
fields.label: Deductee PAN

fields.description: The Income Tax section this tax falls under, set once when the row is created: 194C for a Work Order payment (contractors), 194-I for an Office Rent expense (rent). Rows from before the field were set 194C by the patch v3_0.backfill_payment_tds_section. Options pinned to services/payment_tds.TDS_SECTIONS by test.
fields.label: TDS Section
